results.name: the capture policy is enforced where the writing happens, not only where the buttons are
an unknown capture policy value cannot be smuggled into the setting
a licence verifies offline against the published key, and the grace period is stated
there is no remote wipe and no kill switch anywhere in the server
every file operation leaves an observable journal entry with its final state
a routine can be rehearsed without doing anything, and both rehearsal and run are audited
search can be confined to one folder, and says what it searched when it finds nothing
